message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CodSpeed

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "master"
  pull_request:
  # `workflow_dispatch` allows CodSpeed to trigger backtest
  # performance analysis in order to generate initial data.
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  codspeed:
    name: Run benchmarks
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install -U pip 'setuptools>=45' pytest pytest-codspeed

      - name: Build extension
        run: python setup.py build_ext --inplace

      - name: Run benchmarks
        uses: CodSpeedHQ/action@af75f77f17a054769abefaa42fe8dc2975469b5f # v5.6.3
        with:
          mode: simulation
          run: pytest tests/test_benchmark.py --codspeed

  codspeed-walltime:
    name: Run walltime benchmarks (XXH3 long inputs + short-input controls)
    # CodSpeed macro runners (codspeed-macro) are only available to
    # organization repositories, so this uses a standard GitHub runner.
    # Expect more run-to-run variance than on dedicated hardware.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install -U pip 'setuptools>=45' pytest pytest-codspeed

      - name: Build extension
        run: python setup.py build_ext --inplace

      - name: Run benchmarks
        uses: CodSpeedHQ/action@af75f77f17a054769abefaa42fe8dc2975469b5f # v5.6.3
        with:
          mode: walltime
          run: pytest tests/test_benchmark_xxh3_long.py tests/test_benchmark_xxh3_short.py --codspeed
",
  "rationale": "The workflow installs Python dependencies (pip, setuptools, pytest, pytest-codspeed) on every run without caching. Evidence from P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) shows adding a pip cache keyed on pyproject.toml reduces median elapsed time by ~9%. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9) also demonstrates caching dependency downloads yields ~6% elapsed savings. Adding a cache step for ~/.cache/pip in both jobs is a minimal, safe change that preserves all build and test coverage while reducing repeated dependency downloads.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
